verses.text: When you sit down to eat with a ruler, pay close attention to what is in front of you.
If you have a big appetite, put a knife to your throat to control it.
Do not crave his fine food, because it may be a trick.
Do not wear yourself out trying to get rich. Be wise enough to stop.
Why set your eyes on riches that are here one moment and gone the next? They suddenly grow wings and fly off into the sky like an eagle.
Do not eat the food of a stingy person. Do not crave his fine food,
because he is always thinking about how much it costs. "Eat and drink," he says, but he does not mean it.
You will throw up the little you have eaten and waste your kind words.
Do not speak to fools, because they will look down on your wise words.
Do not move the ancient boundary stone. Do not take over the fields of orphans,
because their Defender is strong. He will take up their case against you.
Set your heart on instruction and your ears on words of knowledge.
Do not hold back discipline from a child. If you punish him with a rod, he will not die.
Punish him with the rod, and you will save his life from the grave.
My son, if your heart is wise, my own heart will be glad.
Deep inside, I will celebrate when your lips say what is right.
Do not let your heart be jealous of sinners. Always keep respecting the LORD.
There is surely a future for you, and your hope will not be cut off.
Listen, my son, and be wise. Keep your heart on the right path.
Do not join those who drink too much wine or stuff themselves with meat,
because drunks and people who overeat become poor, and too much sleep dresses them in rags.
Listen to your father, who gave you life. Do not look down on your mother when she is old.
Buy the truth and do not sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
The father of a good child has great joy. Whoever has a wise son delights in him.
Let your father and mother be glad. Let the mother who gave birth to you celebrate.
My son, give me your heart. Let your eyes follow my ways.
A prostitute is a deep pit, and an unfaithful wife is a narrow well.
She hides and waits like a robber and makes many men unfaithful.
Who has trouble? Who has sorrow? Who is always fighting? Who is always complaining? Who has bruises for no reason? Who has bloodshot eyes?
Those who stay up late drinking wine, those who go looking for bowls of mixed wine.
Do not stare at wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup and goes down smoothly.
In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a poisonous viper.
Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will think confused thoughts.
You will feel like someone lying in the middle of the sea, or someone lying at the top of a ship's mast.
You will say, "They hit me, but I am not hurt! They beat me, but I don't feel it! When will I wake up so I can go and get another drink?"
